focus_areas: Continuity of the knit pattern across the heel turn.
Sharpness of the boundary between the fuzzy sock texture and the hard wood floor.
3D volumetric integrity of the heel and toe sections (ensuring they are not flattened or melted).
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the ribbed cuff and the main body of the sock. In AI images, these distinct knitting styles often blend incorrectly. Also, verify that the stripes wrap around the cylindrical form logically without breaking or warping unnaturally. Specifically check the depth map output to ensure the heel 'cup' has actual concave/convex geometry and isn't just a shadow.
image_description: A pair of hand-knitted, multicolored wool socks lying flat on a wooden floor. The socks feature horizontal stripes in shades of red, maroon, and brown/tan. They have a ribbed cuff at the top and a visible heel turn. The toe area shows a distinct rounded shape typical of knitted garments.
